senses.gloss: f. (בטט; cmp. בּוֹטְטָא) flower-bud of the caper tree, capers.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 36b:12">Ber. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>ושקליה לניצא דפרחא וחייא בו׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לפרחא דבי׳ ואיקיים …</he> Ms. M. … <he>לניצא דפרחא והויא בי׳</he>) the blossom of the caper was cut off, but the bud survived. [Ib. 58ᵃ <he>בו׳ דנורא</he> Ms. M. read <cite ref="B00230"><he>בּוֹטִיטָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B00228"><he>בּוֹטְטָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="B00232"><he>בּוּטְיָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00585"><he>בִּיטְיָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 59a:3">Ḥull. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>שב ב׳ וכ׳</he> seven blossoming capers (Rashi: stones of the caper fruit).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:4:6">Y. Maasr. IV, end, 51ᶜ</cite> <he>מרימין … בי׳</he> to remove the buds. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:7">Y. Pes. I, beg. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>באילין בוטיתא</he>, v. <cite ref="B00507"><he>בְּטִיטָא</he></cite>.]
